The question asks for the name of the work written by Louis Pierre Vieillot published two years after he described the great blue turao as Musophaga cristata. The Predicted Answer provides "**Nouveau Dictionnaire d’Histoire Naturelle**," while the Ground Truth Answer states "**Ornithologie**." These are two different works by Vieillot. "Ornithologie" (published in 1816-1818) is the correct work associated with this context, not "Nouveau Dictionnaire d’Histoire Naturelle."
